about.text: Made with whole cow's milk, without skimming. Creamy cheese, soft mass and slightly sour flavor.

sources.text: whole-milk curd cheese, creamy, slightly acid, salted; the article says it keeps about 45 days; its rennet is a calf stomach soaked in sour orange or lemon juice and sun-dried, so animal rennet (coagulation kept as plant because of the citrus treatment is doubtful; treat as rennet)

facts.v: Aged, it turns yellowish, dry and full of holes; then called queso paraguay duro
